note: People named in the syllabus (guest lecturers, session leads). A week's track lists `people: ["<id>"]` in syllabus.json and the site renders each id as a chip with a hover card. `id` is the slug used from syllabus.json, so keep it unique and stable. `name` is shown on the chip, including any title (e.g. "Ms Natasha Banks"). `role` and `affiliation` form the line under the name; either may be an empty string. `bio` is a sentence or two. `achievements` is a short list of bullet points (keep to 2-4; an empty list hides the section). `photo` is optional and falls back to initials: put images in public/staff/ or public/mentors/. `href` is optional and links to the person's page (external URL, or a path on this site); the hover card hides the link when it is absent.
